Description: Spend passive points to rank up masteries. They draw on the same pool as your attributes, so every rank here is a point of Strength, Dexterity or Intellect you gave up.

berserker.Description: Hone your melee craft: increased melee damage.

sharpshooter.Description: Steady your aim: increased ranged damage.

arcane_focus.Description: Channel raw magic: more spell damage and cheaper casts.

swarm_commander.Description: Command a larger, deadlier host: an extra minion slot and more summon damage per tier.

warlord.Description: All-round martial prowess: increased damage of every kind.

deadly_precision.Description: Find the weak points: increased critical strike chance.

armor_breaker.Description: Your blows bite through plate: increased armor penetration.

frenzy.Description: Attack faster with every weapon type.

brutal_impact.Description: Send enemies flying with heavier knockback.

ironhide.Description: Toughen your hide: increased defense. Scales with your armour, so it stays worth the same as you upgrade.

fortitude.Description: Increased maximum life. Multiplies the life your Strength grants rather than competing with it.

stoneskin.Description: Shrug off blows with percentage damage reduction.

second_wind.Description: Recover faster: increased natural life regeneration.

fleet_footed.Description: Move faster in and out of combat.

rend_notable.Description: Notable: convert 2% of your damage per tier into Bleeding. Bleeding is physical - it faces the enemy's armour instead of elemental resistance and cannot be warded, so it is the reliable answer when an elemental matchup goes bad (but weak against the heavily armoured).

immolation_notable.Description: Notable: convert 2% of your damage per tier into Fire. Converted damage faces the enemy's Fire resistance instead of armour - strong against foes weak to Fire, weak against those that resist it.

venom_notable.Description: Notable: convert 2% of your damage per tier into Poison. Converted damage faces the enemy's Poison resistance instead of armour - strong against foes weak to Poison, weak against those that resist it.

frostbite_notable.Description: Notable: convert 2% of your damage per tier into Cold. Converted damage faces the enemy's Cold resistance instead of armour - strong against foes weak to Cold, weak against those that resist it.

shock_notable.Description: Notable: convert 2% of your damage per tier into Lightning. Converted damage faces the enemy's Lightning resistance instead of armour - strong against foes weak to Lightning, weak against those that resist it.

bloodthirst_notable.Description: Notable: leech 2% of the damage you deal as life per tier (8% at max), a few times per second. Scales with your weapon, so it never falls off.

detonate_notable.Description: Notable: killing an enemy has a (20 + 2 x tier)% chance to detonate it, dealing 10% of its maximum life to nearby foes in a growing radius.

close_quarters_notable.Description: Notable: while an enemy is within 10 tiles, you deal 10% more damage and take 10% more damage per tier. A brawler's stance — reward for fighting at knife-range.

momentum_notable.Description: Notable: while moving, you deal 8% more damage per tier. Nothing while standing still — reward for staying mobile.

executioner_notable.Description: Notable: you deal 10% more damage per tier to enemies below 35% life. Reward for finishing what you start.

adrenaline_notable.Description: Notable: killing an enemy grants +5% attack speed per tier for 4 seconds, refreshing on each kill. Reward for cutting through a pack.
